doc.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29

title: Great New Orleans clarinetists and Parenti's heavy work schedule
summary: Naming clarinetists such as Yellow Nunez and the Barbarins, then Parenti describing multiple theater, nightclub and restaurant jobs a day.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals
